_comment: ILLUSTRATIVE STARTER SAMPLE — NOT official Environment Agency data. Committed fallback so a fresh clone builds/tests without the large real dataset. It uses non-geographic 'ZZ' pseudo-postcodes (plus the well-known low-risk SW1A 1AA) so no real location is mislabelled. The real data lives in data/flood-postcodes.json (git-ignored), produced by: node scripts/build-data.mjs <Postcodes_Risk_Assessment_All.csv> <version>. Source when loaded: Environment Agency 'Flood risk: postcode search tool data' (England only), Open Government Licence.
